name: High Road clincher

origin.basis: Maxxis says it began in 1967 as a bicycle-tire maker in Taiwan.

manufacturing.basis: Maxxis' size table does not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Tube-type version of the High Road Gen 2 race tire.
weight_basis: Maxxis claims for the black foldable clincher SKUs.

availability.note: Listed on Maxxis' US site with a dealer locator. Mainland China listings sell a newer third-generation M230 High Road (CNY 398 per tire at a Maxxis dealer on 2026-11-01) that this record does not cover. European availability not verified in this pass.

caveats: Unusually light claimed weights; tan-wall and older 170 TPI SKUs weigh more.
Bicycle Rolling Resistance's 2019 High Road test predates this generation and is not applied.
Maxxis' International site now presents a third-generation High Road, listed separately; this record keeps the generation shown on Maxxis' US site.

image.shown: Maxxis render of the High Road on its US product page; Maxxis shows this render for the clincher and TR versions, and the construction is not visible.
image.alt: Maxxis High Road road tire render with sidewall logo

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.
